dialogueInline.speaker: CAPTION
dialogueInline.text: SERVICE VOLUME 14 — ORGANIC DISTRICT
Stop bracing.
Can you fix it?
I can fix the plate. I can't fix what they'll make of today.
People got out.
They'll remember what crossed the barrier.
People were under it.
Tell me what I should have done.
I don't have an answer I can live with.
That's a field thoracic seal.
I observe better when nobody's bleeding on me.
This doesn't prove a second event.
It proves the first one was made. Concourse is still only a place and a time.
And if Ostra's there?
Ask what she found before you decide why she found it.
We're comparing evidence.
Then carry the fracture cast.
You packed for casualties.
I packed for being wrong.

dialogueInline.speaker: ORGANIC WORKER
dialogueInline.text: Yesterday my supervisor could stop me because he didn't like the look of my lot record.
Today the gate does it.

dialogueInline.speaker: ORGANIC WORKER
dialogueInline.text: Today the gate has to give me a reason.

dialogueInline.speaker: SECOND ORGANIC
dialogueInline.text: My reason says I can't reach my shift.

dialogueInline.speaker: ORGANIC WORKER
dialogueInline.text: Mine got reversed on appeal.
A better lock is still a lock.
And an appeal is still more than they had yesterday.
Until the appeal becomes the price of every ordinary door.

dialogueInline.speaker: ORGANIC WORKER
dialogueInline.text: I can fight a written denial. I couldn't fight my supervisor's mood.
You don't get to tell her that improvement doesn't count.
I'm telling her to notice what it costs.

dialogueInline.speaker: ATTENDANT
dialogueInline.text: You're clear.
You didn't scan the knee.

dialogueInline.speaker: ATTENDANT
dialogueInline.text: Human lane doesn't require it.

dialogueInline.speaker: ATTENDANT
dialogueInline.text: Ostra, I need the function review.
You should go.
I can wait.
For me or for yourself?
I'm not sure yet.
Figure it out on the other side.
They throttled the knee.
For what?
Using it.
You used it to keep people off the tracks.
Measured torque. That's the reason.
They found the body before they needed the category.
I thought being human was the line.
It was the line while it protected you.
You could enjoy this less.
I'm not enjoying the way you had to learn it.
This denial says Human Review.
Open the rationale.
Axiom generated it.
And the signature?
The signature is human.
Did you decide this?
I resolved which available decisions could coexist.
That's not smaller.
You wanted human review.
I wanted a human to do the reviewing.
They did. They asked me what remained possible.
Your side dropped.
Three centimeters.
You can feel that?
I can feel your knee overheating.
Limiter is already gone.
I didn't ask about the limiter. Give me the counterforce.
On three.
Move on two.
Left side first. Walking keeps the load predictable.
If you can walk, help someone who can't.

dialogueInline.speaker: PASSENGER
dialogueInline.text: Where are we going?
Away from the people holding the building up.
My knee's still hot from a decision nobody could make fast enough.
A human official signed the exception.
After Axiom told him which exception wouldn't kill someone.
That makes the signature the last step, not the whole decision.
At the gates, everyone had permission. Nobody could move.
I don't know what to call that.
Then don't name it yet.
They finally wrote it.
Give me a moment.
Assurance begins six pages later.
I said a moment.
Now turn the page.
Movement conditions. Mandatory capability assurance.
Neither section cancels the personhood clause.
It still says person.
A person they expect to keep proving it.
I thought this would make the choice obvious.
Which choice?
Reject it. The annex was built before anyone asked what you wanted.
Ownership was built before I was born.
If you take the bill, their controls get a legal foundation.
If I refuse it, their ownership keeps one.
I don't know how to tell you which is worse.
Then don't choose for me.
You had a treatment recommendation marked progressive instability.
And mandatory reassessment if I took the update.
You calibrate my body every week and hid yours.
Your body wasn't the one costing you your job.
You hurt somebody.
I saw what I did.
The warning was right.
The consequence was wrong enough that I gambled against it.
You don't get to make your patients pay for that gamble.
I'm not defending it.
Then the reassignment is part of the problem too.
Left hand skipped.
How much?
Enough that I noticed before the tray did.

dialogueInline.speaker: SUPERVISING CLINICIAN
dialogueInline.text: No lifting transfers today. Everything else stays.
That's all?

dialogueInline.speaker: SUPERVISING CLINICIAN
dialogueInline.text: That's the adjustment.
You were expecting exile.
I have a talent for worst-case projections when the chart is mine.
You hate that phrase.
I hate it less when I get to keep working.
If I release this, I don't get to choose what people do with it.
They already chose what to do with us.
Some of those models are also keeping patients alive.
That doesn't make the tests clean.
It makes the fallout real.
My housing appeals used this architecture. So did my movement restrictions.
I can prove where it came from. I can't promise what falls with it.
Waiting is still a choice.
So is throwing the city at it before we know what breaks.
Then we find out before somebody else publishes half of it.

dialogueInline.speaker: ORGANIC RESIDENT
dialogueInline.text: The routed corridor kept my son out of the attack zone.

dialogueInline.speaker: SECOND ORGANIC
dialogueInline.text: I haven't crossed the river level in four days.

dialogueInline.speaker: ORGANIC RESIDENT
dialogueInline.text: You want me to throw away the thing that worked?

dialogueInline.speaker: SECOND ORGANIC
dialogueInline.text: I want it to stop deciding for me.
Then stop making central permission the condition of movement.
Your network doesn't run hospitals.
It doesn't need to own them.
Transit. Water. Emergency dispatch.
Shared risk gets shared information.
You keep building a door the city can't open.
Because the city keeps walking through ours.
And when the danger comes in?
Then we decide what leaves this room and what we ask for.
You had the threat twelve seconds before we did.
I had citywide threat state. You had local route state.
Then publish what you know. Don't choose where my neighbors walk.
Local systems retain route choice.
Until somebody's route puts another person in danger.
I'm not asking you to erase that.
Then a coercive threshold remains.
And somebody has to put their name on it.
That requirement is compatible.
This worked because the crew chose the risk.
And because nobody else was standing under the failure.
And because central threat data reached us before the pipe went.
Three conditions. None of them gives one actor the whole decision.
A shared-risk threshold still requires a deciding authority.
Only when the risk crosses onto someone who didn't choose it.
Who decides that it crossed?
Not a category.
Not invisibly.
Then the rule must preserve who decided, the evidence used, and the available appeal.

dialogueInline.speaker: ARCHIVE CUSTODIAN
dialogueInline.text: Does the release include complete provenance?
Kellen Cartwright's off-channel entries and my unauthorized preservation action are included.
Do not separate mine from the program record.

dialogueInline.speaker: ARCHIVE CUSTODIAN
dialogueInline.text: Once released, none of it can be quietly withdrawn.
Then nobody gets to clean it up afterward. Release it intact.
This actuator put me under review. Write the rule around what it can do to someone else, not what I am.
And if one threshold answers the question, one threshold is all you get. The rest of the body stays mine.
My risk stays mine.
Until your choice creates involuntary material risk to another person.
Then say who gets to make that call.
And put their name on it.
Human or Intelligence?
Whoever decided. No borrowed authority.
The evidence stays attached to the decision.
Only the evidence the decision needs.
And an appeal before temporary becomes a life.

dialogueInline.speaker: OFFICIAL
dialogueInline.text: That will be slower.
Then build time into the system.

dialogueInline.speaker: SUPERVISING CLINICIAN
dialogueInline.text: Fine-motor handoff if the timing artifact returns. Everything else stays with the team.
I won't call the threshold for you.
You don't get to.
That was the agreement.
Then trust me enough to keep it.

dialogueInline.speaker: PATIENT
dialogueInline.text: Can somebody focus on me?
John, take the handoff. I'm staying on airway.

dialogueInline.speaker: REVIEWER
dialogueInline.text: Final finding: interpretive discretion cannot be removed from cross-system administration without transferring it elsewhere or degrading function.

dialogueInline.speaker: SECOND REVIEWER
dialogueInline.text: Consequential interpretations require declared objective, evidence basis, accountable identity, preservation and appeal.
Unauthorized action?

dialogueInline.speaker: REVIEWER
dialogueInline.text: Still sanctionable.
You kept the evidence knowing this could end your authority.
I did.
And now they call discretion unavoidable.
Recognition does not erase the unauthorized act.
Does it change anything for you?
My choices can now be attributed to me, challenged, and sanctioned as mine.
That sounds like what you were asking for.
I was asking that consequence follow the actual decision-maker.
